text:
sophie: Heads-up: PMs asked for a clear "go/no-go" checklist for multi-region routing + tenant isolation. Need a lean launch that handles EU residency requests and supports graceful failover. Thoughts?
mohit: We should split acceptance into Product (behavior), Infra (ops), and Commercial (billing/SLAs). Also call out tenants that opt-in vs enforced residency.
lia: Product POV: minimal features to ship = region-affinity header, policy DSL to mark tenants as "region-locked", failover map that selects compatible model variants, and a rollout canary. No live migrations in v1.
ryan: Technical flags: cross-region fallback breaks KV locality and can spike tail latency. For v1 we can do: (a) fallbacks go to a warmed standby for critical tenants only, (b) implement a per-tenant fallback toggle. We need metrics for cold-warm delta.
sam-ux: From UX/sales enablement: customers expect a clear note in console and in API responses when a request is served out-of-region. Need a structured warning and telemetry link.
jess: Finance check: naive fallback = more egress + duplicated cache. Estimate +20-40% spend under failover. We need a threshold guardrail and automatic opt-in to Dedicated pricing if exceeded.
mohit: SLA language suggestion: "Cross-region failover available; not guaranteed for region-locked tenants. For tenants with residency requirements, fallback will be disabled unless customer accepts outbound transit in writing." I'll draft precise wording.
lia: Rollout plan (proposal): 1) internal canary (5% non-critical traffic) 2) external pilot with 2 customers (opt-in) 3) expand to 20% with monitoring gates 4) global enable.
ryan: Gating metrics we should enforce before increasing %:
- p95 end-to-end <= 140ms on canary traffic
- fallback error rate < 0.4%
- KV cache miss penalty (median cold-warm delta) quantified and < 65ms additional
- egress delta <= 15% forecast or manual approval
- no unhandled data-residency violations in audit logs
infra-bot: infra-note: prewarm-job created: `kv-prewarm/affinity-v0` - ticket #3789 (auto-post) :white_check_mark:
sophie: Good list. Two more constraints: we must not silently move EU tenant data, and any tenant with residency flag requires a documented exception process. Add those to gating.
jess: Also require cost-monitoring alert: if monthly cost delta for a tenant > 12% trigger sales outreach.
mohit: Assigning owners: me = SLA + comms, lia = rollout playbook + pilot coordination, ryan = infra reliability & prewarm experiments, jess = cost signal + pricing path, sam-ux = console warnings & docs.
lia: I'll add a compact rollout checklist to the playbook: canary flag, monitoring dashboard, rollback automation, postmortem template. Will attach link when ready.
ryan: Two technical mitigations to shrink tail: (1) partial prefix replication for hottest keys (best-effort), (2) adaptive throttling to protect origin region. Both will be experiments in parallel.
sophie: OK. One decision we need now: do we offer cross-region fallback as "on by default for hosted customers" or "opt-in"? I'm leaning opt-in to reduce blast radius. Thoughts?
jess: Opt-in reduces surprise billing and legal risk. Recommend opt-in for residency-constrained customers and default-off for others, with clear docs and an easy opt-in path for pilot customers.
mohit: Agree on opt-in. We'll present that to sales.
sam-ux: I'll mock a console flow for opt-in + warning modal and an API parameter for per-request override (with audit).
sophie: Final: opt-in default, pilot flow, gating metrics above, owners assigned. Reconvene next Wed to review playbook + infra ticket status. Thanks everyone.
